summary.business_type: Online IPTV subscription sold over WhatsApp, with 199 country landing pages
summary.scope_note: Production build of commit 32303a2 served locally. www.ottv.org returned HTTP 402 DEPLOYMENT_DISABLED, so nothing is indexable today.
top_findings: 197 country pages share one template, an 88% median word match
15 third-party service logos hotlinked with no rights statement
No seller identity, terms, privacy policy, payment method or licensing statement
Wrong language or time facts on some country pages
quick_wins: Correct language facts and Comoros raw codes
Make Fire TV steps 3 and 5 work for trial users
Show player-app fees next to the $0 trial caption
Add a price summary to the first screen of /pricing

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Single-hop 301 redirects on the local build

findings.title: Live domain disabled
findings.description: www.ottv.org and ottv.org return HTTP 402 DEPLOYMENT_DISABLED.

findings.title: No Content-Security-Policy
findings.description: Header absent on the production build.
findings.recommendation: Add a CSP in report-only mode first.

findings.title: IndexNow not automated
findings.description: The route needs INDEXING_API_SECRET and a post-deploy call.
findings.recommendation: Configure and call after each deploy.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Core pages and guides read clearly
Guides state they were checked against vendor documentation, not tested on every device

findings.title: Scaled template country pages
findings.description: 197 pages at an 88% median word match, with no OTTV fact varying by country.
findings.recommendation: Owner decision: add real per-country service facts, consolidate, or noindex.

findings.title: Wrong language and time facts
findings.description: South Africa, Ukraine, Montenegro and Comoros are confirmed on the page; Zimbabwe and Nigeria look doubtful.
findings.recommendation: Review all 197 language rows against government sources.

findings.title: Unsubstantiated catalog counts
findings.description: 25,000+ channels and 120,000+ titles have no published support.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Titles unique and at most 60 characters

findings.title: No plans on the first screen of /pricing
findings.description: The only link above the fold at 1366 and 375 px is the breadcrumb.

findings.title: Promotional prices omit related costs
findings.description: $0 and from $7.35 leave out player-app fees and the $88.23 upfront payment.

findings.title: Thin Offer markup
findings.recommendation: Add availability; return policy is an owner decision.

findings.title: HowTo markup has no rich result
findings.description: Emitted on 11 guides; no rich result since September 2023.
findings.recommendation: Harmless. Leave, or remove when next touched.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Lab LCP under 1.3 s on 8 pages

findings.title: Provisional lab score
findings.description: Localhost lab data only. No field data and INP not measured.

findings.title: Slow menu tap under throttling
findings.description: 248-320 ms for one tap at 4x CPU slowdown. A lab probe, not INP.
findings.recommendation: Confirm with field data before optimizing.

findings.title: No identifiable business entity
findings.description: No legal entity, About page or sameAs.

findings.title: Ambiguous brand name
findings.description: OTTV mostly means a building-energy metric on Wikipedia and Wikidata.

findings.title: Hotlinked third-party logos
findings.description: 15 service logos load from iptvwell.com and are mislabelled in source as press brands.
findings.recommendation: Owner decision: remove, or confirm rights and self-host.

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Publish legal pages with owner approval

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Add internal links to top markets
